In this paper, a machine learning algorithm is proposed to consider the applications of different types of devices in the network and to ensure that they provide the right amount of resources. With this the required amount of resource is first calculated and based on that the divine amount of resource is allocated to them. Thus the lack of resources there is completely avoided.

articleTitle: Hybrid CNN & Random Forest Model for Effective Curry Leaf Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This abstract evaluates the efficacy of a model of classification in identifying and classifying different diseases of plants. To measure the model's efficacy across multiple illness classes, recall, precision, F1-score, support, percentage, or accuracy metrics were used. Notably, the model identified "Leaf Spot Diseases" (84.03%) or "Powdery Mildew (Erysiphe spp.)" (77.98%) with excellent precision and recall rates of "Leaf Curl Diseases" (74.45%) or "Viruses" (69.09%). The weighted average measures (precision: 85.40%, retention: 86.00%, F1-score: 84.90%) demonstrate the system's general robustness in dealing with uneven class distributions. The macro average numbers (precision: 70.85%, remembering: 67.45%, and F1-score: 70.11%) show consistent and equitable results across all classes. This study emphasises the model's efficacy for early illness identification and provides insight into effective agriculture disease management tactics.

articleTitle: Cloud-Powered Precision: Revolutionizing Fault Detection in Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Electric current plays a vital role in human existence as it underpins numerous aspects of our daily lives. Without current, life as we know it would cease to exist. To meet the ever-growing demand for electricity, various types of power stations have been developed. Among these, thermal power stations stand out as a major contributor, accounting for approximately 70% of current production. However, ensuring the smooth functioning of different sections within a thermal power station goes beyond simply calculating current production. Continuous monitoring of these sections is imperative to guarantee their optimal performance. To address this need, we propose the implementation of an expert system that can monitor the various sections of the power station seamlessly, eliminating the need for manual intervention. Additionally, this system would transmit data wirelessly, enhancing convenience and efficiency. In a thermal power plant, coal combustion in the boiler serves to convert water into steam within the boiler tubes. This steam, characterized by high pressure and temperature, flows into the turbine, causing it to rotate. The turbine shaft is connected to the generator shaft, which also rotates as a result. This rotational motion generates power. Safeguarding the operational parameters of the power system is crucial for maintaining the health of power-generating equipment and ensuring the efficient utilization of electricity by customers. Therefore, continuous monitoring and frequent inspections of both the customer's equipment and the power plant itself are essential. By implementing an expert system for continuous monitoring, the thermal power plant can achieve enhanced operational efficiency, improved equipment reliability, and effective utilization of resources. This proactive approach helps identify potential issues promptly, reducing the risk of equipment failures and optimizing power generation processes.

articleTitle: Deepfake Detection: A Multi-Algorithmic and Multi-Modal Approach for Robust Detection and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In a time when deepfakes are eroding the reliability of digital media, our innovative research introduces a multi-faceted framework that achieves unprecedented levels of detection accuracy. Boasting a 97% success rate in verifying visual content and an almost unblemished 98.5% in audio analysis, our system serves as a formidable barrier against the malicious alteration of digital assets. Central to our model's stellar performance is the seamless integration of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with ReLU activation mechanisms, all fine-tuned via stochastic gradient descent (SGD). This expertly engineered architecture is highly proficient at analyzing the nuanced spatial features of visual media, and it works in synergy with cutting-edge machine learning algorithms. For the audio detection aspect, we employ random forest algorithms, celebrated for their robustness and versatility. This ensemble learning approach adds an extra layer of complexity to the model, effectively identifying the intricate spectral and temporal characteristics of audio streams, thereby boosting the overall efficacy of our detection system. Our methodology is further fortified by meticulous data preprocessing methods, such as normalization and data augmentation, which ensure the model's robustness against a myriad of deepfake techniques. This groundbreaking research not only establishes a new benchmark in the arena of deepfake detection but also has significant ramifications for the wider field of cybersecurity and the preservation of digital authenticity. With its unmatched performance metrics, our research represents a pivotal advancement in combating the growing menace of deepfakes in today's digital society.

articleTitle: Unveiling E-Commerce User Behavior through Deep Learning Evolutionary Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This study delves into the realm of E-commerce user behavior analysis using a novel approach that combines deep learning and evolutionary data mining techniques. With the explosive growth of online shopping and digital transactions, understanding user behavior has become paramount for businesses to enhance their services and increase customer satisfaction. In this paper, we propose a framework that leverages the power of deep learning algorithms to extract intricate patterns and insights from vast amounts of E-commerce data. Additionally, we integrate evolutionary data mining methods to refine the analysis process, allowing the model to evolve and adapt to changing user preferences over time. Through extensive experiments on real-world E-commerce datasets, we demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in uncovering hidden behavioral trends, predicting user actions, and optimizing personalized recommendations. Our findings underscore the significance of amalgamating deep learning and evolutionary data mining to gain a comprehensive understanding of E-commerce user behavior, thus empowering businesses to make informed decisions in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

articleTitle: Comparative Assessment of deep learning methods for Prediction of Uterine Fibroid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Today, convolutional networks, a type of deep learning algorithm, are frequently used in medical science. Automatic disease detection, in particular, is of great importance in the medical field. For the detection and classification of tumors, it is necessary to segment the affected region and the tumor. In general, medical imaging techniques are used to diagnose the tumor, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MR), ultrasound (US) and computed tomography (CT). Our study surveysdeep learning's applications for image classification, object detection, segmentation. Accurate segmentation of the affected region, tumors, and spine from MR images remains challenging, however it is still challenging to achieve because of 1) Wide differences in the size and shape of tumors amongst individuals; 2) the lack of contrast between tissues and organs that are next to each other; and 3) the undetermined number of tumors. Neural networks are able to capture the region and tumors [2]. The survey concludes with current findings and an analysis of open research challenges and directions.

articleTitle: Solar Based Parking Cum Charging Station for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: As the car industry enters a new age, it is swiftly transitioning from IC engines to electric vehicles. Electric vehicles are becoming more popular. This increases the need for charging stations as well. This paper presents a theory for charging electric vehicles wirelessly without a chord using inductive coupling. So, the parking slot is completely transformed into a power source using solar panels. One of Nikola Tesla's most important discoveries was the idea of wireless power transfer. Also, an Internet of things-based collection system is designed in which a person can use the RFID to pay the charging charges of that vehicle. The system checks if the person has sufficient balance and then deducts the charging charges and updates the balance. The phrase "Internet of things" refers to a system of physical objects that are linked using sensors and other technologies to share data with other hardware and software. As a result, the system does not require any human intervention. Vehicles can be charged wirelessly via inductive coupling and payment can be made for charging via RFID tags as a result of this paper. So wireless power transmission is a technology that could play a significant role in shaping the future. The paper discusses the potential of this technology to enable wireless charging in various aspects of our daily lives, presenting new opportunities for its application.

articleTitle: Monitoring the Student's Entry and Exit Time in the Classroom
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Monitoring the student's entry and exit time into a classroom is a crucial task. This system will be a solution for performing that crucial task. In this system, for face detection and face recognition, two pre-trained models were imported and utilized to create face embeddings for a collection of photographs kept in a file directory. The face embeddings and corresponding labels are then used to train an SVM classifier using the scikit-learn library's SVC class. To detect and recognize the students, the pre-trained face detection and recognition models were loaded using OpenCV's dnn module. Then the saved face embeddings and labels were also loaded using pickle, which was previously generated by a face recognition model. Face detection is performed using a Caffe model trained on the SSD framework, while face recognition is done using OpenFace. The system identifies the student's faces using embeddings that were generated by pre-processing the images and were saved in the face_embeddings.pickle file. It then matches these embeddings to the corresponding labels that were saved in the labels.pickle file. Then the input is captured from the webcam and the optical flow analysis is applied to detect motion in the video stream. After that, it initializes the input image with a blurred, grayscale image and sets the starting points for the motion tracking. It then loops over the captured frames, blurs and converts them to grayscale, and uses calcOpticalFlowPyrLK to calculate the new points based on the old ones. If the new points are within a certain range, it draws a line between them on the input image and displays it. If the points move outside a certain threshold, it triggers an event to log the entry or exit of a student from a classroom and appends these details into a text file accordingly. Finally, this text file is sent through email to a specified list of recipients (faculties) on a daily basis.

articleTitle: Real Time Weather Forecasting System Using NodeMCU ESP8266
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Nowadays, humankind uses sophisticated technologies in every sector, from healthcare to Weather forecasting. Weather plays a significant role in our life as our daily activities rely on it. So to achieve accurate results, we are using the internet of things as its source extends everywhere. Our proposed model is developed on Node MCU using the internet of things. We can sense various parameters through different types of sensors like temperature, humidity, the intensity of light, quality of air, and rainfall. We can forecast the weather based on these, and accordingly, we act. With our proposed design, we can get accurate results and monitor the weather forecast from anywhere. Through this weather forecast system, the daily life activities of farmers and individuals will be enhanced.

articleTitle: Face Emotion Based Music Recommendation System Using Modified Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In this paper, proposed a new vision to personify music recommendation by face emotion recognition technology. Emotions play a crucial role in the way humans perceive and respond to music. This system aims to enhance the user experience by recommending music based on their real-time facial expressions, allowing for a more immersive and emotionally resonant listening experience. So here employed deep learning techniques to detect facial emotions accurately and use them as input to our music recommendation algorithm. The proposed method modified convolution neural network ensures user privacy and data security by processing emotions locally on the user's device without uploading any sensitive information to external servers. Through experimental evaluation, here demonstrate the effectiveness and usability of the emotion-based music recommendation system and finally shown this method is very effective with the help of accuracy and F1 score.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimized Energy Efficient Routing Protocol for Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks Based on Grey Wolf and Bat Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Efficient communication is paramount in wireless sensor networks, particularly when faced with the constraints of limited node power. Underwater Acoustic Sensor Networks (UASNs) hold a crucial role in environmental observing, disaster prediction, and ocean studies. The challenge lies in maintaining seamless data transmission while conserving energy, necessitating robust routing protocols. This study introduces a Hybrid Optimized Energy Efficient Routing Protocol (HOEERP), combining the strengths of the Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) and Bat Algorithm (BA). HOEERP initializes a diverse population with solutions from GWO and BA. The GWO phase refines communication paths using grey wolf hierarchy, while the BA phase utilizes bats' echolocation-inspired exploration. A dynamic hybridization mechanism adjusts algorithm balance over time, enhancing adaptability. Mutual learning between wolves and bats enhances solution quality. Fitness aggregation and selection merge solutions, guiding the search towards optimal energy-efficient routing paths. Solutions are decoded into paths, considering node energy levels and distances. Simulations demonstrate HOEERP's superiority over individual GWO, BA, and existing methods, enhancing metrics like energy consumption, packet delivery, throughput, and data loss. HOEERP is a significant UASN advancement, maximizing communication reliability, minimizing energy consumption, and adapting to changing conditions. This hybrid methodology paves the way for more efficient underwater communication networks, contributing to enhance environmental monitoring and marine research endeavors.

articleTitle: BABYBLOOM – Nurturing Pregnancy and Parenthood with Personalized Care
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: "Babybloom" is a revolutionary mobile application designed to provide expectant mothers with comprehensive support and efficient baby care solutions. This personalized app transforms the journey of pregnancy and parenthood by catering to individual needs. Through personalized pregnancy tracking, "Babybloom" offers tailored recommendations based on due dates, medical history, and preferences, ensuring accurate and relevant information. Week-by-week updates and interactive 3D visualizations enhance the understanding of baby growth. Certified experts conduct virtual prenatal classes covering childbirth preparation and postpartum care. The supportive community fosters engagement and experience sharing, creating a sense of togetherness. The intelligent symptom analyzer offers personalized advice and facilitates consultations with healthcare providers, ensuring informed decisions. For postnatal care, "Babybloom" integrates with smart baby monitors for real-time tracking and timely alerts. It provides age-appropriate activities and expert-recommended parenting tips to track developmental milestones and support cognitive and motor development. Virtual paediatrician consultations and a daily wellness dashboard ensure convenient healthcare access and monitor well-being. Additionally, "Babybloom" plays a crucial role in predicting ideal food choices. Calculating calories from consumed food items, the app assesses the user's body health condition and suggests suitable foods. In conclusion, "Babybloom" empowers expectant and working mothers through personalized care, expert advice, and a nurturing community. It simplifies the journey of pregnancy and parenting, enhancing the experience for every mother.

Author Keywords: intelligent symptom analyzer and Smart baby monitor integration

articleTitle: Fine-Tuned EfficientNetB0 Model for Brain Tumor Multiclassification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Brain tumors are caused mainly by DNA abnormalities, which result in aberrant cell division, prolonged cell lifespans, and the creation of aggregative masses inside the brain. Such tumors prevent the brain from operating at its best, sometimes resulting in long-term problems. These tumors' genesis (primary or secondary) and malignancy (benign or malignant) are used to classify them. While some might not be immediately lethal, their growth or contact with healthy brain tissue might cause damage. Investigations into various approaches, such as conventional medical imaging and artificial intelligence (AI), mainly using deep learning (DL) and transfer learning (TL), is prompted by efforts to identify and categorize brain tumors. Implementing the EfficientNetB0 model, which is famous for its adaptability and efficacy, is an excellent demonstration of this strategy. This work uses a well-curated dataset of 3264 photos from various classes to closely analyze the use of the EfficientNetB0 TL model to identify and classify brain tumors from MRI scans. The model's adaptability and accuracy are meticulously examined using a dual-pronged strategy incorporating transfer learning and fine-tuning, yielding an astounding accuracy of 98.5%. Accuracy and loss charts illustrate the model's learning development in vivid detail, and a well-defined confusion matrix provides extensive insights into categorization effectiveness across various tumor classifications. The achievement of a 98.5% accuracy rate highlights the potential paradigm change made possible by AI and TL in the diagnosis and classification of brain tumors. This accomplishment confirms the efficacy of such sophisticated procedures and promises to speed up diagnosis, enable prompt therapies, and improve patient prognoses. The combination of AI and TL heralds a new era of precision medicine, ready to reshape the field of brain tumor care as research in this area grows.

articleTitle: Assistive Device for Differently Abled People
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: It is difficult to focus on and solve the issues experienced by persons with varied abilities, such as those who are visually, audibly, or vocally handicapped, using just one technology. Lastly, based on the Raspberry Pi microcontroller and a few more parts, this research proposes an assistive gadget for those who are blind, deaf, and dumb. Raspberry Pi as the main microcontroller, a touch screen display for being user friendly, a Bluetooth microphone that uses the voice bot app, an earphone for the voice output Pi camera for object detection, UART and HC 05 as Bluetooth modules, and an ultrasonic sensor for obstacle detection are all included in the system. We are mainly focusing on six important objectives in this paper which include: Speech to text, text-to-speech using Google API, image- to-speech, face recognition to save and recognize photographs of close relatives in both voice and text, obstacle detection, and gesture recognition are the device’s six main goals. The gadget is based on the Raspberry Pi and makes use of its capabilities and computing power. It also has a 3.5- inch touchscreen for user- friendliness. The system’s elements work together to produce a complete and simple aid for people with disabilities. The device’s performance, advantages, and possibilities for advancement in the future are all thoroughly examined.

articleTitle: Exploring Active Machine Learning Techniques to Boost Classification Accuracy in Image and Text Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive analysis of active machine learning algorithms designed to improve the classification precision of image and text models. This study introduces the ALiPy (Active Learning in Python) library, which provides a platform for readily integrating active learning algorithms into classification models. The proposed method enhances model performance and reduces annotation costs by selecting informative cases for annotation using the query-by-committee (QBC) procedure. The technique’s efficacy is evaluated utilizing the AG News text dataset and the CIFAR-10 image dataset. Experiment results indicate that using active learning strategies significantly enhances classification accuracy in both domains. The ALiPy library can be used by academics and professionals to research and evaluate active learning methodologies. This research advances the implementation of active learning techniques and demonstrates how this can improve the classification accuracy of image and text models. The findings demonstrate the importance of employing active learning strategies to maximize data annotation efforts and enhance the functionality of machine learning models in real-world settings.

articleTitle: Automatic music generation using RNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: this paper explains the development of music automatically. Deep learning is employed in order to do this. In the shape of an ABC note sequence, melody is created. Using vast amounts of data for music is presently feasible. mostly for the creation of music utilizing deep learning For modeling, it utilize LSTM or GRU. In terms of music creation, it is comparable to sequence creation. Since LSTM creates sequences most effectively, using it is recommended. Subjective evaluation is carried out by people with diverse backgrounds, including classical music interest, performance, composer, and digital composer. The results reveal that the double stacked layer LSTM model outperforms the composer pattern in music, with a 70% recall score. Furthermore, subjective evaluation indicates that the created music is listenable and intriguing, with a score of 6.85 out of 10 on double LSTM stacked layer.

articleTitle: Efficient Dynamic Clustering Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Generally, Data Mining or Knowledge Discovery is the procedure of analyzing information from various viewpoints and summary the data for further information Clustering is an unsupervised learning process where it generates an object group based on their similarity in such a way that the objects fit into another group are same and those belonging to other are dissimilar. Initialization of cluster size and iteration is the major problem of data clustering traditional clustering mechanisms like fuzzy C means algorithm and K-Means algorithm. To overcome the problems in data clustering a novel clustering mechanism is proposed in this research named Efficient Dynamic Clustering Mechanism. Our proposed mechanism computes the centroid value using Gaussian distribution and this system computes the new clusters depending on the distance between the data points. Finally, we conduct a set of experiments to prove our proposed Efficient Dynamic Clustering Mechanism is rather than other approaches.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection Using Auto Encoder And Cnn
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Plants are regarded as indispensable due to the fact that they constitute the primary source of energy generation for humanity as a result of the nutritive, therapeutic, and other benefits that they possess. Plant diseases can harm the leaf at any moment between crop farming, which can result in massive damages to crop yield and economic market worth. Thus, the diagnosis of leaf diseases is an extremely important part of the agricultural industry. However, it requires a significant amount of manual labour, more time for preparation, and in- depth understanding of plant pathogens. In many instances, these researchers also obtained significant results in both scenarios. This previous research served as inspiration for the model of plant leaf categorization that we suggested in this paper, which makes use of auto encoders for feature extraction and is pre-trained with MobileNetV2.Our experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art models.

articleTitle: Efficient and High Performance Ternary SRAM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In every application static random access memory is used for high speed register , cache and relatively small memory banks such as a frame buffer in the increased demand of SRAM with large use in system on-chip . It stores information in the form of binary values due to this reason it require more number of cells. Nowadays, ternary logic is popularly used and It is the best substitute for traditional binary logic because of its storage capacity and delay that results from reduced degree of complexity in interconnects and chip area. This project proposes the design of standard ternary inverter, by arranging ternary standard inverters back to back a Trit storage element is implemented as a ternary SRAM cell and continuous read operation is obtained by Transmission gate technology. We measure the performance by considering the parameters area, delay and power. Tanner T- spice based circuit simulation of the proposed designs were carried out, Simulation result demonstrates an increased performance of area and delay for the Proposed design as compared to the existing design.

articleTitle: Detection of Chronic Kidney Diagnosis Using RNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Chronical kidney diseases commonly known as chronic renal illness, is a kind of Kidney disease is characterized by abnormal kidneys function or breakdown of renal function that takes a long time or months to complete. Chronic renal disease are frequently discovered during those individuals are recognized to be at danger of renal obstacle, Those who have high blood pressure or diabetes, for example, are tested, as well as those who have a blood family who has chronic kidney disease as a result, swiftly prognosis is a critical in battling the disease and providing effective therapy. Deep learning implementation techniques such as CNN & RNN for CKD is suggested in this article. Using the fewest features, the final outcome forecasts either the person have CKD or not.In our research we will be using algorithms the convolution Neural network (CNN) as existing system & recurrent neural Network (RNN) as proposed system and compared in terms of Accuracy. From the results its proved that RecurrentNeuralnetwork (RNN) performs better than ConvolutionNeuralnetwork(CNN).

articleTitle: Developed 3D- Improved Ensemble Deep Neural Network to Detect and Predict PD at the Early Stage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Parkinson's Disease (PD) was the most common neurodegenerative illness. Since there is currently no cure for this illness, better diagnostic methods and therapeutic approaches are crucial. Many genes and proteins linked to PD exhibit aberrant expression, according to findings from microarray & proteomics. However, many researchers specifically examine protein-protein interactions (PPI) in PD. In post-mortem brain tissue samples from patients with Parkinson's disease, differentially expressed (DE) genes were identified using microarray-based gene expression information and PPI datasets. Development of a hybrid 3D-Improved Ensemble Deep Neural Network with Levy Selfish Herd Optimization (3D IEDNN-LSHO) method to forecast the initial signs of PD was recommended in this paper using a particular structure depending on grid search optimization. To evaluate the DL algorithm, various hyperparameters must be established or modified. Based on speech examples of PD patients & healthy people, the proposed approach was evaluated. The analysis of the method's findings reveals that by fine-tuning the DL algorithm's variables, the overall assessment performance increased to 89.23% and the median classification accuracy increased to 91.69%. The development of PD applications may make use of these network biomarkers as possible treatment options.

articleTitle: Analysing the Customer Behaviour using Reinforcement Learning for Business Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This study focuses on leveraging reinforcement learning techniques for analyzing customer behavior to drive business development strategies. In the modern competitive landscape, understanding and predicting customer preferences and actions are crucial for sustaining growth. Reinforcement learning, a branch of machine learning, offers a unique approach to model customer interactions and optimize decision-making processes. This paper explores the integration of reinforcement learning algorithms into business environments to create adaptive strategies that respond to customer behavior in real-time. Through a synthesis of existing literature and empirical research, the study aims to showcase the effectiveness of reinforcement learning as a tool for understanding and leveraging customer behavior dynamics in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

articleTitle: Effect of Meandered Inductor on the Resonant frequency of Metamaterial Inspired Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Microstrip antennas based on Zeroth Order Resonators are simulated and developed, and it has been discovered that they are incredibly small in size. Microstrip patch is designed on FR4 epoxy substrate having relative permittivity of 4.4. The thickness of the substrate is 1.6mm. It has been amply established that the length of the meandering inductor utilized in the design is very important in determining the operating frequency of the antenna. The theory of Composite Right-Left-Hand-Transmission-Line (CRLH-TL) is employed in the design. The volume occupied by the antenna is 15.84 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> which stays the same regardless of the length of the meandering lines. Simulated three distinct antennas with peak gains of 0.6dBi, 6.3dBi, and -5.8dBi at 3.3GHz, 5.6GHz, and 2.45GHz, respectively. One such antenna resonating at 3.3GHz is fabricated, and its measured resonance frequency of 3.313GHz with a peak gain of 0.4dBi is obtained. The results from simulation and measurement correspond fairly well.

Author Keywords: phase propagation constant Zeroth Order Resonators

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Port Scanning and SQL Injection Vulnerabilities with correlating factors in Web Applications to Enhance secure Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The increasing use of web applications has led to a rise in vulnerabilities, with SQL injection being one of the most prevalent and harmful attacks. Attackers exploit flaws in how web applications handle user input to manipulate database queries and gain unauthorized access to sensitive data or perform destructive actions. This article aims to explore the working of SQL injection attacks and highlight the role of port scanning in such attacks. By understanding the causes and mechanisms behind SQL injection, we can better comprehend the importance of proper input validation and parameter handling in securing web applications. The study reveals that web applications vulnerable to SQL injection can be exploited through port scanning to identify open or closed ports, like MySQL's default port 3306. Attracting malicious SQL code into user input fields can alter database queries and potentially compromise the application's security. SQL injection remains a significant threat to web applications due to poor input validation and inadequate handling of parameters in SQL queries. Proper security measures, such as input validation and parameterization, are crucial to mitigate the risk of SQL injection attacks and enhance overall application security.

articleTitle: Enhancing Indoor Air Quality through an Automatic HVAC Duct Cleaning Bot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Heating Ventilating and Air conditioning systems is commonly used in large buildings to maintain the inner temperature and to improve the air quality. Improving air quality will help in minimizing the air borne diseases. The mandatory component of the HVAC systems are the air ducts. Keeping air ducts clean is important to increase the efficiency of the HVAC systems. Manual cleaning of the air ducts is time consuming and very difficult process. To automate the cleaning process and to detect the dust in the air ducts, an application-oriented system is designed. This system uses advanced camera along with the processor to detect any dust or other particles present in the duct pathway. The captured images will be compared with the images which are preloaded in the microprocessor memory. If the system detects any dust, the user will be intimated with the alert and the bot started cleaning. The model is provided with four gearing motors attached wheels which can make the bot to move freely inside the air ducts. This model can be operated using remote also. The chassis is designed to withhold the total load. The total loads are the processor, battery, water tank other hardware components like relays, drivers and servomotors. The user will be provided with a graphic user interface where they can see the live telecast of the duct and the alert intimation. The user can also take a decision and the bot can be operated manually also.

articleTitle: Prediction of Ovarian Syndrome Using Deep Feature Representation and Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The high incidence of the polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) among fertile women receives more and more attention. Women's physical and mental health may be at risk due to the common disorder PCOS, whose identification is an expanding issue in worldwide public health. In this work, we looked into the potential significance of abnormalities in the identification of PCOS and provided information-based feature representation and learning techniques (IFRL) for PCOS auxiliary identification. Here, a real-time dataset is acquired from the Coimbatore region by examining 74 individuals, and these samples are used in the algorithm. The suggested method performs pre-processing, feature learning and classification using the proposed IFRL. To achieve categorization, a multi-instance model was finally built. Several performance indices were used to evaluate our method's effectiveness, including AUC, precision, recall, accuracy, and F1-score for classification.

articleTitle: ATOMM: Enjoy and Experience the Music
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: "Atomm: Enjoy And Experience The Music" is a project that aims to develop a music application Our music application is a comprehensive platform that offers a range of features and services for music enthusiasts. The app provides users with access to a vast and diverse library of songs, playlists, and podcasts from around the world. The interface is designed to be user- friendly and intuitive, making it easy for users to navigate and find the content they are looking for. The music application employs state-of-the-art algorithms to recommend personalized content based on the user's listening history, preferences, and behaviour. The app also features a social component, allowing users to connect with friends and share their music preferences, playlists, and recommendations. One of the key features of the music application is its robust audio quality and streaming capabilities. The app supports high-quality audio streaming, ensuring that users can enjoy their favourite songs in the best possible audio quality. Additionally, the app provides offline playback, enabling users to listen to their favourite content without an internet connection. Overall, the music application is a one-stop-shop for music enthusiasts, providing them with an unparalleled music experience on-the-go.

articleTitle: Visually Impaired Job Alert Provider App
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Today, the issue of unemployment is central, especially among visually impaired people, the application aims to provide a solution to this, and the main goal of the project is to help visually impaired people find work in several different ways. It makes it easy for people to apply for various jobs and helps them to improve their lifestyle and find solutions to various daily challenges. It announces jobs on the portal through voice commands, which helps them to know the job details easily. The user applies for a suitable job, in the registration form it receives information such as name, age and qualification category by voice, it saves the information entered by the user and finally, the application gives the user a confirmation message by voice.

articleTitle: Integrating Advanced Machine Learning Techniques for Multi-Class Skin Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Dermatology is the study of skin disorders that can differ based on location and environmental conditions. Skin is challenging to analyze due to its unevenness and other factors, and those in remote areas may lack access to medical care and neglect symptoms, which can worsen over time. Thus, an automated system for identifying skin diseases is necessary. Our deep learning model distinguishes between healthy and diseased skin and categorizes diseases such as Melanocytic Nevi, ActinicKeratoses, Melanoma, Dermatofibroma,Benign keratosis-like lesions, Basal cell Carcinoma and Vascular lesions. We employed a form of machine learning known as Deep Learning that uses large datasets to decrease the number of classifiers needed. Our model uses the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to classify images. Skin conditions can be infectious and life-threatening if not detected early. Most are caused by overexposure to Ultraviolet Radiation (UR). Our system aims to minimize risks by detecting skin diseases automatically. However, skin appearance can vary, which poses a challenging task.

articleTitle: AR Upgraded Windshield
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: A driver must always keep their eyes forward and maintain a safe distance from moving vehicles or pedestrians in order to drive safely. Additionally, the driver must pay attention to everything around the vehicle and check the GPS for information. Due to the driver's restricted field of vision and inability to focus for extended periods of time, there is a high likelihood of malfunctions and accidents. The usage of AR Systems is a viable option for preventing these potentially fatal circumstances to the greatest extent possible. They improve the driver's comfort and give them awareness of potential hazards and impediments. so ensuring safety and lowering the likelihood of accidents

articleTitle: Detecting Botnet Attacks in IoT Healthcare Systems through IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The Internet of Things(IoT) has fundamentally changed how technology can be used, but it has also created new opportunities for cyberattacks. These days, there are more IoT devices linked to the network than ever before. IoT device proliferation has led to the emergence and rapid evolution of dangerous attacks including IoT botnet assaults. The study focuses on how IoT devices’ inadequate security features make them susceptible to attacks. By interfering with IoT healthcare system(IoT-HCS) networks and services, these attacks hinder the move to the IoT environment. Particularly, IoT Botnet attacks have become an important risk to IoT-HCS, with hackers employing them to execute widespread attacks on servers and networks. In this situation, Machine Learning(ML) has shown promise as a method for identifying and thwarting these attacks. The paper suggests several ML approaches including Decision Tree(DT), Extreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost) and Logistics Regression (LR) to detect Botnet attacks in the IoT-HCS. In order to achieve this, the publicly accessible IoT Botnet attack dataset is used. The aforementioned ML techniques have been compared using the IoT Botnet dataset based on a number of evaluation metrics, including recall, F1-score, accuracy, and precision. According to the results, the accuracy rate for the DT model is 98%, while that of the XGboost and LR models is 95% and 89% respectively.

articleTitle: CKD Prediction using Mixed Dataset Concept and Deep Learning: A Combined Approach for Accurate Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a significant health concern worldwide, requiring early detection and intervention for improved patient outcomes. In this study, a novel approach is proposed, that combines two diverse datasets, obtained from Kaggle and UCI repositories, to create a balanced and comprehensive dataset for CKD prediction. Unlike conventional methods, feature selection is refrained from in order to retain the richness of information present in the datasets. The combined dataset undergoes undersampling to address class imbalance, followed by training a Feedforward Neural Network (FNN) model for accurate prediction. This experiment reveals promising results, with an accuracy of 98.88% and a low loss of 0.0259. Additionally, a case study is presented to illustrate the practical application of the model by predicting CKD status based on a specific row index. This study demonstrates the potential of utilizing mixed datasets and deep learning techniques for robust CKD prediction, thereby facilitating early diagnosis and intervention.

articleTitle: Model Spy Bot Using Li-Fi Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The idea behind choosing the model military spy bot is for the safety monitoring and surveillance of human activities in the war prone zones or in the geographical borders with the aim of reducing infiltrations from the enemies. The spy bot has an inbuilt integration of wireless IP camera that can transmit videos from the war prone zones in order to prevent the damage and loss to human lives. Soldiers face many difficulties while entering the unknown territory, because of lack of environmental awareness. The spy bot will serve as a significant instrument for the defence sector to reduce the loss of human life and will also prevent illegal activities. It will help all the troops and armed forces to know the condition of the territory before entering it. This spy bot has a Gas sensor to analyse the toxic gases, fire sensor to give alert if there is any presence of fire in spy bot path, motion detection sensor to detect the presence of enemy in the way of spy bot, metal detector sensor to detect the landmines, all the sensor’s parameters will be transmitted using li-fi technology. The signals transmitted from the user’s smartphone helps in vehicle motion and then the camera mounted on the spy bot will take the video live streaming. The live streaming information is transferred to the user’s smart phone through the Wi-Fi system.

articleTitle: ANI-SOUL –A Voice-Assisted System for Animal Identification and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: According to the current breakdown of the world’s land area, 10% of the planet is covered in glaciers, 19% is desert, 1% is freshwater, 11% is grassland, and just 37% is still covered in forests. Only half of the land is categorized as "Habitable Land". As a result, animals frequently stray into agricultural areas in search of food and shelter. According to forest officials, roughly 4000 complaints are filed each year about wild animals damaging crops. Farmers do have to deal with animal grazing and pest infestation in addition to their crop loss. To put it in a nutshell, they need a third eye on their farm to enhance safety. To overcome this issue our application - "Ani-Soul"- will help to identify the animal with a "voice automated system" and classify it into wild or domestic. If it turns out to be a wild animal, the forest department will get an "automated alert call" with the animal’s name and the precise coordinates of the animal activity, and this animal activity automatically informs the forest department in case if the animal is classified as ‘wild species’. However, if it’s a domestic animal, the farmer will be informed and given a snapshot of the animal along with its precise arrival time. To ensure alertness calls are sent iteratively until the client picks up the call. If no one answers the phone, the voice alert speaker positioned in the central village is activated (to notify the inhabitants). You Only Look Once (YOLO), a well-known object detection technique, is used to assist in identification. It uses one of the best neural network designs to provide high accuracy and quick processing. Further, OpenCV, Twilio, and Python 3.0 are used to uplift the application performance.

articleTitle: Data Reduction Algorithm: Identification and Elimination of Erroneous rows
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Data Reduction without the removal of exact, correct rows is a crucial pre-processing step. Large Datasets make it difficult to model data effectively or forecast results accurately. Additionally, they demand lengthy processing times, sophisticated complexity software and thorough data cleaning. The incorrect and irrelevant rows may produce inaccurate results that impair the performance of the model. For better and more accurate outcomes it is crucial to properly detect and remove inaccurate data. The proposed algorithm calculates the Initial Recall value of the Dataset. It eliminates least correlated features using the Correlation Matrix. Using Gaussian Curve, for all the columns it identifies and eliminates rows having values which lie beyond (μ ± 3σ). Furthermore, it takes into account the column with the highest Standard Deviation, selects the nearest 50% Left and 50% Right values from that column's mean. It selects only those rows and calculates the Final Recall value. Negligible difference between Initial and Final Recall values implies that the removed rows had no or minimal impact on the Dataset's final result. This algorithm is implemented on 3 Standard Medical Datasets - Pima Diabetes, Heart Attack and Breast Cancer. For the Breast Cancer Dataset, this algorithm eliminated the highest number of rows that is 231.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Recognizing the affective qualities of speech while ignoring its semantic content is the goal of Speech Emotion Recognition (SER). Automatically conducting this activity using programmed devices is still a work in progress, despite the fact that people can do it efficiently as part of voice communication. Predicting a person's emotional state based on their words is the goal of speech emotion recognition. It enhances inter-human communication between computers and people. Despite the fact that predicting a person's emotion is challenging due to the subjectivity of emotions and the difficulty of annotating audio, "Speech Emotion Recognition (SER)" enables this through its capacity to comprehend human emotion. Tone, pitch, expression, conduct, etc., are all states that can be used as indicators of an individual's emotional state. Existing systems are not only not real-time, but also only support a single emotion. Current speech emotion prediction models are based on SVM algorithms, which might take a long time to train in order to achieve high classification accuracy. Unfortunately, the current models lack a scalable framework. Since it makes use of natural language processing, the suggested system is both precise and efficient.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Methods to Predict Bankruptcy among Manufacturing Companies in India Post-IBC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to study the impact of financial variables on the bankruptcy prediction of Indian manufacturing companies by performing a comparative analysis between various machine learning predictive techniques. 15 financial variables are selected for the prediction of bankruptcy after the implication of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) 2016. For comparative analysis, machine learning predictive techniques used in this paper are Logistic Regression, Artificial Neural Networks, Decision Tree, and Random Forest.

articleTitle: Tracing the Motion in High-Speed Video Frames Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: One of the most important jobs of a self-driving vehicle's visual system is to identify and categorize obstacles along the route. Cars need to be detected, categorized, localized, and linked across frames if they are to be tracked. With the low cost and high utility of visual information, vision-based technologies have gained popularity for this purpose. In this paper, we develop a deep learning-based motion tracking from high-speed video frames. The model is developed using deep convolutional neural network that makes it to be applicable for classification of objects in the video frames. The deep convolutional neural network classifies the obstacles present in the pathway and offers a better classification pattern than the conventional models.

articleTitle: Enhancing Photovoltaic Efficiency in CsSnI3-Based Perovskite Solar Cells through Optimal Defect Density
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The utilization of lead-based perovskite solar cells (PSCs) in commercial applications is significantly limited due to concerns over their toxicity and stability. Perovskite-based photovoltaic (PV) cells are right now at the forefront of thin-film PV research and development due to their high-power conversion efficiency (PCE) and ease of manufacture. Perovskite materials based on Pb or Sn elements have been employed in the fabrication of solar cells. In instances of this nature, the utilization of tin-based inorganic PSCs can play a crucial role in advancing the performance of PSCs to exceptional levels. In this context, we want to present a theoretical exploration of a PV device known as a CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based PSC, which possesses the desirable attributes of being lead-free, environmentally sustainable, and dependable. The present study involves the utilization of SCAPS software to conduct device modelling of PV cells based on CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. The bulk defect density of the buffer layer, specifically CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, has been altered from 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. Based on the comprehensive findings, it can be shown that the PV CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> metrics exhibit maximum values when the defect density of CsSnl3-based PSC is reduced. When the concentration of faults reaches its minimum level of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, the PV values exhibit enhancement as seen below: The observed results consist of a PCE of 23.3%, a V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> of 0.87V, a J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf> of 30.76 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, and an FF of 86.69%. These findings underscore the significance of mitigating the bulk defect density in CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-based PSCs in order to attain enhanced efficiency. Through additional investigation and advancement, it is plausible that PSCs devoid of lead, which rely on CsSnl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> as the active layer, could present a more environmentally friendly and enduring substitute for conventional lead-based PSCs.

articleTitle: Smart Load Operating System Using DTMF Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The design provides addicts with a great way to store and manage home/office items and other clothing from their mobile phones. Extends the life of robotization control equipment. This approach is based on embedded processes. In this design, we want to have a unique Dual Tone Multi-Frequency (DTMF) robotic system combined with a wireless module that allows seamless control of many variables and home functions. This article presents a control system that uses DTMF tones that are generated when a key on the mobile phone keypad is pressed or connected to the mobile phone remote control. The advantage of this system is that it can work in any remote or remote area. The system is designed to control household appliances by calling from a mobile phone. Calls can be made from the home phone or from outside. The system was created by ARDUINO UNO, but based on digital understanding, it uses DTMF technology (Dual-tone multi-frequency) to receive commands from the phone to create a digital business. This digital signal is also re-used to direct a relay driver to turn the load on/off. Beyond the limitations of other IR and RF control modes, it can be used to turn devices on or off from anywhere. The concept of this system gives a new direction to the construction of home robots.

articleTitle: Securing Children Based On IoT And Emotion Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Children’s safety is a major concern today. Child trafficking occurs frequently every day. This paper seeks to address parent’s concerns about the safety and security of their children. This model proposes three modules like finding the location of children through GPS, the second module is used to mark the attendance of children who are present inside the classroom using iBeacon, and the third module is used to predict children’s emotions through random forest algorithm. This paper gives a solution to find the location of children both by parents and teachers using the Android application and to take attendance as well as to identify the location of children inside the school campus by teachers. The mood states of the student, such as joy, sadness, fear, disgust, shock, anger, and neutrality, are automatically detected by the facial expression. This prediction will help the teacher to analyze in which subject the children are most interested. The main motive of this paper is to monitor the children wherever he/she goes and to predict the emotion. This system is developed using PIC microcontroller, GPS and iBeacon.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Gradient Boosting and Random Forest for the Classification of False News
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The rapid increase in the utilization of social media for news browsing is attributed to its capacity, affordability, improved attractiveness, and accessibility, leading to the dissemination of "fake news." The widespread propagation of fake news has unintended negative effects on individuals and culture. Certain individuals exploit social media platforms to disseminate false information, seeking attention and reaping monetary and political advantages. To effectively distinguish between authentic and false news, intelligent solutions are required. The Gradient Boosting Classifier and Random Forest Classifier are the two ML classifiers that we compare and contrast in this research work. In comparison, the Gradient Boosting Classifier outperforms the Random Forest Classifier, achieving an impressive accuracy of 92% in classifying fake news.

articleTitle: Enhanced study on Deep learning model for kidney segmentation using DCE-MRI
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Medical imaging is capturing pictures of bodily components for diagnostic or research reasons. Because of advancements in image-handling techniques, which include picture recognition, examination, and upgrading, clinical imaging is expanding swiftly. Picture division is a vital subject in picture handling and PC vision with applications, for example, scene grasping, clinical picture examination, mechanical discernment, video observation, expanded reality, and picture pressure, among numerous others. Numerous picture segmentation methods have been created and are available in the literature. There has been a lot of work done to develop techniques for segmenting pictures using deep-learning models since they have proved effective in various vision applications. Deep learning has turned into a functioning exploration point in the field of clinical picture examination. Compared to the laborious and lengthy conventional technique, deep learning (DL) automatic detection algorithms can speed up diagnostics, increase test accuracy, lower expenses, and lessen the workload on the radiologist. Kidney segmentation is an integral part of any non-intrusive computer-assisted diagnostic (CAD) system for rapidly recognising severe renal repudiation because of the intensity of inhomogeneity brought on by errors in the image capture process, efficient kidney segmentation is challenging in evaluating and therapeutic planning of kidney-related disorders. This article addresses recent developments in DL-based kidney tumor segmentation systems. We highlight their fundamental components and numerous approaches as we discuss the main medical image kinds, segmentation methods, and evaluation standards for segmentation outcomes in kidney tumor++ segmentation.

articleTitle: Pictoquizezz: Engaging Cognitive Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In the era of virtual interactions, finding innovative ways to engage participants in activities such as quizzes can be exciting. One captivating approach is hosting a virtual quiz without relying on keyboards and a mouse but solely utilizing webcams, active internet, and hand gestures. The virtual quiz utilizes computer vision algorithms to detect and track hand gestures through participants' webcams. By mapping specific gestures to different quiz actions, participants can select answers and interact with the quiz interface without the need for traditional input devices. Participants are presented with a series of questions displayed on the screen, and they can indicate their chosen answer by making specific hand gestures. Monitor the participants' webcam feeds attentively to identify their hand gestures. Provide immediate feedback on the accuracy of their responses, indicating whether they are correct or incorrect. This feedback mechanism ensures that the quiz serves as an educational tool, promoting a continuous learning experience. The use of AI in virtual quizzes can enhance the experience by providing personalized learning time-saving quiz generation, instant feedback, and adaptable difficulty. By leveraging webcam technology and hand gestures, this virtual quiz offers a novel and immersive approach to quiz participation. The virtual quiz employs computer vision algorithms to identify and monitor hand movements using participants' webcams. This innovative concept aims to create a fun and engaging experience for participants, encouraging active participation and knowledge retention through gesture-based interactions.

articleTitle: Mango Varieties Classification using EfficientNetB2 Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Mango is widely acknowledged as a popular tropical fruit appreciated for its delightful and indulgent flavor. It is commonly noted that mango holds a special significance as the national fruit of India. It offers diverse options, highlighting unique qualities, flavor profiles, and visual attractiveness. In recent years, deep learning-based applications have demonstrated impressive accuracy in image-based classification. The research paper comprehensively analyzes the diverse factors considered during the study. The research employed the EfficientNetB2 model in a simulation, using a constant learning rate of 0.0001 for 18 epochs and a batch size 32. The dataset consists of 1600 images that have been organized into eight distinct categories such as Anwar Ratool, Chaunsa (Black), Chaunsa (Summer Bahisht), Chaunsa (White), Dosehri, Fajri, Langra, and Sindhri. Every class represents a unique variety of mango. The dataset is divided into three distinct types of data: training data, testing data, and validation data. The training data comprises 1280 images, while the testing and validation data includes 160. The procedure utilized the Adam optimizer. The model's accuracy is assessed using precision, recall, and F1-score. The overall accuracy is reported to be 98%. Mango varieties can enhance culinary experiences, promote agricultural sustainability, and contribute to the long-term conservation of this cherished fruit.

articleTitle: Enhancing Real-World Image Deblurring: Algorithm Selection and Performance Evaluation for CCTV
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: To restore clear photos from blurred photographs due to camera movement, several image deblurring techniques have been developed. Deblurring is th process of taking off blurs and bringing back the sharp image. Defocus, motion, Gaussian, average, and other types of blur are only a few examples. We want to identify the bes algorithms for real-world problems (such as CCTV and traffic camera images) in this project. We look at the algorithms used to solve a certain issue. The PSNR and SSIN values will be used as benchmark scores as these chosen methods are tested on actual blurred photographs. Existing datasets can be used to evaluate the performance of algorithms; however, actual data may differ slightly from these. Three major categories can be used to categorize deblurring techniques: blind and non-blind, regularization, deep learning, and hybrid methods. We are focusing on applying the best algorithm for deblurring photos in this to produce incredibly effective results.

articleTitle: EEG Signals: Current trends and Future Aspects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Human Brain and its working has fascinated the scientists around the world since ages. Although the earlier research was majorly for spiritual purposes but it has been seen that human brain has been tested and tried on various criterion to make the scientist of that time to understand the functioning of it. With the evolution of the medical science and modern technologies, scientists have come a long way to give us a cure to some of the devastating diseases like Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, although the final cure is still a long step away but the studies have added a few more years to the human life. As we know that human brain emits Electroencephalogram Signals or simply the EEG signal, and these are linked with the various emotions linked with specific events. In this paper we will discuss the evolution in the studies of analysis of EEG signals that we have come across especially after the Second World War.

articleTitle: Predicting the outcome of future football games using machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Sports predictions has gained popularity as a topic of study thanks to the development of sports analytics and the accessibility of extensive and sophisticated match data. In this paper, a machine learning-based (ML) strategy for forecasting football match results is presented. In the past, the number of goals scored by each team in a football (FB) game served as a benchmark for assessing a team's performance and projecting future outcomes to forecast the results of football games, such as win, draw, or defeat. However, there are significant discrepancies between a team's performance and the number of goals scored or conceded throughout many games because the number of goals scored during a match contains a significant random element.The goal of this study is to create an accurate and dependable prediction model that will help fans, analysts, and bet enthusiasts make wise selections. The selection of features, treatment of data that is imbalanced and the generalization of models constitute significant issues that are addressed in this paper. The system learns patterns from previous encounters and player attributes to develop predictions for upcoming games. Various machine learning algorithms, including random forests (RF), support vector machines (SVM), and regression, are experimented with. The main goal of this research is to investigate various Machine Learning techniques to forecast football game results utilizing in-game match events and individual and team statistics off the field. As football remains a globally popular sport, the integration of machine learning for match prediction offers an exciting avenue for enthusiasts to enhance their understanding and enjoyment of the game.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Dynamic Journey from Data Insights to Action in Data Science
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The emergence of data science hastransformed the way organizations analyze and utilize data. By combining statistical analysis, machine learning, and domain expertise, data science enables valuable insights and data-driven decision-making. This paper explores the evolution, key components, and applications of data science across industries such as healthcare, finance, and marketing. Challenges related to data quality, privacy, and the demand for skilled professionals are also discussed. The future of data science lies in leveraging emerging technologies and addressing ethical considerations. Overall, data science plays a pivotal role in shaping the future, unlocking new possibilities, and driving positive societal impact.

articleTitle: Ai Hologram Video Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This visionary concept seeks to revolutionize the field of holographic video generation by leveragingthe immense potential of deep learning methodologies. The overarching goal is to create an innovative system that can seamlessly convert standard 2D videos into mesmerizing 3D hologram videos, which can be experienced through a simple and accessible pyramid structure. This novel approach aims to eliminate the complexities associated with conventional methods that require intricate camera setups and multifaceted perspective captures.The journey begins with the acquisition of a diverse dataset containing 2D videos, forming the bedrock for subsequent transformations. In the initial stages of data preprocessing, pivotal features are extracted from the input videos. Following this, a dynamic process of spatial and temporal transformations unfolds. This intricate choreography enlists the services of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which takes on the role of extracting spatial features from each individual frame. The CNN’s discerning gaze captures intricate visual nuances, bringing them to life within the holographic realm. Concurrently, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network enters the stage, diligently capturing the subtle dance of temporal dependencies. This synergy augments the resulting holograms with an enhanced sense of depth perception, evoking a truly immersive experience.At the heart of this innovation lies a Fusion Neural Network, meticulously designed to harmonize the spatial and temporal features into a cohesive symphony. This orchestrated fusion births a feature representation that epitomizes the marriage of visual dimensions. This harmonious blend embarks ona transformative journey through the realm of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). Within the GAN’s adversarial embrace, the feature representation unleashes a process of alchemical creation, conjuring forth holographic scenes that are breathtakingly lifelike and endlessly dynamic. This adversarial interplay, where a generator contends with a discriminator in a bid to refine the authenticity of the holographic fabric, is the crucible in which realism is forged. The grand culmination of this voyage is the emergence of a sophisticated system, poised to unravel the very fabric of conventional 2D videos. This astonishing transformation is executed with an exquisitely orchestrated pipeline of neural networks, wherein spatial, temporal, and generative forces synergize. The result is an enchanting array of holographic content, beckoning viewers to traverse the realms of imagination. The pyramid structure stands as both portal and pedestal, inviting audiences into an awe-inspiring experience that transcends the boundaries of traditional video playback. This audacious idea envisions a future where digital and physical realities intertwine, granting us a glimpse of what lies beyond the ordinary horizon of visual storytelling

articleTitle: Image Quality Enhancement and Caption Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Our brain is capable of labeling or annotating any image that is visible to us. But the machine does not have the capability of thinking on its own. To bringing it possible, we are employing Deep Learning Techniques. The aims of image captioning are to produce natural language expressions, to capture the relationship between the objects in the image, and to evaluate the credibility of the constructed descriptions. Uprooted features of the image are handled by Xception. Xception is a CNN model. These extracted features will be permitted by the LSTM model, and it will allow for the image subtitle. When the descriptions provided are just one word long, the object detection task for image captioning becomes more generic. But the problem arises when the image is of poor quality. The Images taken by a user under various lighting circumstances, Dots Per Inch (DPI), and different angles may have worse quality. We are utilizing several techniques, object identification, image classification, CNN, and OCR, to enhance the quality of images.Reducing Noise, Rescaling, Binarization / Thresholding, Removing Skewness / Deskew, and Morphological Operations are a few actionstaken during the image quality enhancement process.

articleTitle: Milk Grade Detection and Analysis of Quality Factors for Dairy Farm Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Milk is a very important drink that is required by individuals of all the ages. Milk is the source of various vitamins and minerals for our body as well as a good source of protein. However, it is equally important to make good quality of milk to be available to the consumer. Milk produced in dairies often carry various disease causing germs due to improper care of the cattle. So, milk quality check is performed. However it is not possible for a human being to go through the large volume of numerical data. So we have to design an intelligent system that is capable of scanning through large volumes of the milk data and extract the parameters. It must also be able to predict with very high accuracy the presence of any kind of anomalies or substances that can harm the quality of the milk that is sold and at the same time help in the E-commerce aspect by farming management with milk testing labs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Password Security through Multi-Split Encryption and Recovery
