publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to password management using Shamir’s Secret Sharing scheme. The methodology involves generating and distributing private key shares, enhancing password security by requiring multiple shares to reconstruct the original key. The system ensures secure password storage through encryption and facilitates robust password resets. By leveraging Shamir’s Secret Sharing, compromised entities cannot breach user privacy, offering a paradigm shift in digital trust. This paper explores implementation intricacies, security considerations, and the potential to reshape password security.

articleTitle: Secure Electronic Banking Transaction using Double Sanction Security Algorithm in Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: E-Banking, recognized as electronic banking or online banking, pertains to utilizing electronic channels and platforms for diverse banking transactions. It empowers clients to access and manage their bank accounts, conducting financial activities via the internet and electronic mediums, including mobile devices. Electronic Banking offers a secure and user-friendly approach for individuals and enterprises to execute banking operations remotely, eliminating the need to visit a physical bank branch. Ensuring user authentication across preferred communication channels is vital for business operations. However, utilizing insecure or unauthorized internet pathways can expose vulnerabilities to cybercrime during transactions. To counter fraudulent activities, the utilization of One Time Passwords (OTPs) has emerged to confirm the user’s identity over wireless channels. An OTP is a singularly valid password for a login session or transaction. Currently, the most prevalent method for user authentication is sending OTPs as SMS to registered mobile numbers. Yet, this approach has its limitations. Sharing the OTP without authentication renders it susceptible to various communication channel attacks. To mitigate this, a proposed solution entails assigning random numbers to specific alphabets printed on the back of the debit/credit cards associated with the respective accounts. During transactions, after inputting and verifying the correct OTP, an additional authentication window emerges. The server then requests the numbers linked to an alphabet from the card’s rear, ensuring that only the account holder possessing the physical card can proceed with the transaction.

articleTitle: A Sophisticated Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Multiple Classification of Apple Leaf Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The identification of crop diseases that is automated is critical because it simplifies the labor-intensive chore of supervising large farms while also identifying illnesses in the beginning stages to minimize plant degradation. Aside from the detrimental impact on plant health, this circumstance has a huge influence on a country's economy owing to decreased productivity. The current method of disease detection used by specialists is slow and unsuitable for big farms. A combination of an 11-layer CNN is used in our proposed technique. Its goal is to divide apple tree leaves into four groups based on images: healthy, scab, cedar rust, and black rot illnesses. On the training dataset, our suggested model attained an accuracy of 96.25%. In addition, the model has a 96% accuracy in recognizing leaves with various illnesses.

articleTitle: Classification of Stellar Using Supervised Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In this paper, we show that machine learning methods may be successfully used to solve the fundamental stellar astronomy challenge of predicting star atmosphere properties from spectral data. In order to enable their decision-making, stellar-atmospheric refraction (SAR) adjustments must be quick, autonomous, and precise for star trackers working in the atmosphere. The article's presentation of a combined approximation both SAR & stargazer attitude (often referred to as S) satisfies this need. A SAR model has been developed using the corresponding refractive coefficients (ERC) and true zenith distances (TZDs). It is recommended to do combination SAR and STA estimate utilizing frequent errors replication (REF) cycle. In contrast to current rectification methods, this proposal avoids the problems involved with theoretical environmental simulations and related empirical models. We use Kohonen identity maps, forward-feeding neural networks, and locally weighted regression to derive actual temperatures, surfaces gravity, or metallic stellar atmospheric properties from spectral indices. Our test findings show that each of the three techniques is very good at predicting parameters. Weighted basis regression outperforms other ways that use the original information as input by a small amount, whereas all self-planning schemes perform better than other techniques while generating a lot more noise. To combine the results from our algorithms, we also use a variety of predictors. When using unprocessed and noisy data, the cluster outperformed every one of the three approaches.

articleTitle: Survey on Current Developments in UAV Secure Communication Techniques and Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The UAV communication network is a rapidly growing technology that uses unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to transmit data over long distances. UAVs are equipped with wireless communication systems to connect with ground networks. There is an increasing use of UAVs for a variety of purposes, including surveillance, delivery, disaster relief, and military operations, which require reliable and secure wireless communication links. UAV communication security must be ensured through encryption, authentication, authorization, and access control mechanisms to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data transmitted over UAV networks. A comprehensive review is provided in this paper of the latest UAV routing protocols, covering centralized-based, distributed- based, cluster-oriented, deterministic, probabilistic, static, dynamic, and social-network-oriented protocols. Following the evaluation of routing protocols, performance metrics, and limitations are analyzed based on the protocol type, objective, and simulation tools. Additionally, we summarize different secure communication techniques.

articleTitle: ResQFeed: Empowering Communities through Optimized Food Rescue
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Food waste is an international concern with broad implications. Millions of tonnes of food that goes unused are wasted annually, putting stress on ecosystems, escalating hunger, and wasting precious resources. Millions of people are currently food insecure. To solve this complex issue, this project aims to tackle the significant problem of food wastage in urban environments by introducing an innovative platform that connects surplus food suppliers such as restaurants, grocery stores, and catering services with local food banks and non-profit organizations. The platform's main goal is to use data analytics to optimize food rescue activities in order to lessen the impact on the environment while also alleviating the food shortage. This platform reduces transportation expenses while guaranteeing that extra food is effectively distributed to underserved areas. This project recognizes the serious problem of expired or uneaten food and seeks to avoid its needless waste by organizing prompt rescues. It seeks to transform how surplus food is handled and shared and thereby contribute to a more sustainable and equitable food ecosystem by encouraging cooperation between food suppliers and charitable organizations and utilizing the power of data analytics for logistical efficiency.

articleTitle: An AI Based Chat Bot For Banking Applications using Intelligent Chat Bots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: A chat and voice assistant that is powered by AI and is integrated into a banking application. This assistant translates data in such a way that the text and audio are designed to simulate human conversations. Since their inception, voice and chat assistants have seen substantial technological advancement. The advancements that have been made in machine learning and natural language processing have made it possible for them to now learn from their experiences and conduct conversations that are more human-like. Because of their more human nature, they are able to assist with a wide variety of tasks, such as calculating loan interests, confirming facts regarding transactions, and checking savings.

articleTitle: Virtual Learning Environment for Visually Impaired People using OCR and TTS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The "Virtual Learning Environment for Visually Impaired People" paper pioneers inclusive education by integrating OCR and TTS technologies. It empowers individuals with diverse abilities to effortlessly access printed and digital content. By converting text into natural speech, the project creates an enriched learning experience that caters to varied learning styles. Through user-centered design and the strategic application of OCR and TTS, our initiative aims to break barriers, promote engagement, and empower differently abled learners to reach their full potential. It results in building a more inclusive future where technology bridges gaps and enhances education for all.

articleTitle: Implementation of Safety Device for Women
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Women’s safety in India is now widely debated every-where. It has now escalated into a major issue. The crime rate is on the rise. Women are not safe at home or in public. Female travellers from foreign nations are likewise in a vulnerable situation when visiting India. However, these worries do not prevent them from participating in any social activity. There are regulations, but there must also be proper security measures that are carefully enforced to protect women from abuse. To tackle this problem, we have come up with the solution of building an advanced women’s security system. We will be using STM32 (Blue Pill), which will drive the entire system along with a GPS module to send accurate location information to the close users, and a Node MCU (ESP32) module will be used as an alert mechanism. It will also use a switch button to start the entire system when needed. We will also focus on the fact that the project is cost-friendly and easy to use.

articleTitle: An effective mechanism for secret sharing in Distributed Blockchain Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The main objective of the paper is for the implementation of a very secure data transmission way. It’s already known that blockchain technology is well-known for security. But still found some issues with storage cost due to data replication at each node, therefore distributed storage blockchain systems came into existence in order to overcome the limitations of traditional systems. Later on, this system was also enhanced to the Distributed Storage Blockchain with the Local Secret Sharing scheme in order to maintain or lower the communicational/ recovery cost-oriented issues. So, here the idea is to integrate the obtained distributed storage blockchain with the Local Secret Sharing schemes mechanism with image steganography to make the private messages much more secure from attackers. The scope of this project is just integrating the obtained encrypted text in Distributed Storage Blockchain (DSB) including the Local Secret Sharing (LSS) scheme with Image Steganography to implement our proposed model.

articleTitle: Protecting the Secrecy of the Video Using Advanced Data Hiding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: We propose a advanced video hiding technique to protect the data which need to be secure so that the piracy and the security of the data is maintained without falling into wrong hands. The message or data such as text , audio , video and files are embedded into a video .The video is of Audio Video Interleave (AVI) format and the data is embedded using h.264 algorithm , slicing and macro block technique. The video is secured using encryption and decryption using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm. The sender secures the video using a key , the receiver can retrieve the data only when the key is entered thus by protecting the data. This method is used to transfer information securely by hiding the data in a video, the third party doesn't know that there is a data hidden in the video , they look just like a normal video without any traces of the data hidden inside it.

articleTitle: Driving Assistance Using Android Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Smart Systems are rapidly increasing in the automobile industry for Transportation, and became as the solution for road safety. Due to the heavy growth in mediums of transportation everywhere, a drastic increase of road accidents is noticed. Vehicles entrenched with excess sensors facilitate us to detect the accidents, tracks the location of accidents and notifies the nearby hospital, police forces and the family members about the accident.The systems that include a sensor, GPS and GSM module etc., can detect the accident. But they are more expensive to install in the vehicles and most of the vehicles may not support them. So, this problem can overcome with accident detection system based on Internet of Things. This system aims to provide the safety to the people in the vehicle using advanced characteristics of Smartphones with low cost.In this situation, an Android application has been developed to collect data about speed, density, and location. LiDAR is also used to monitor the surrounding environment and vehicles moving around it. The speed is used to identify the accidents or possibility of accident in particular location. It occurs because of alterations in climatic stipulations. The data obtained is then measured to sense road accidents. Additionally, navigation system is created to convey the situation to the closest hospital, rescue team and family members.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning based Ischemic Stroke Lesion Segmentation using Modified Multi-Scale 3D CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Acute Ischemic Stroke (AIS) is the second-largest fatal accident that results in High morbidity, disability, and mortality worldwide. Clinicians can help patients receive the right therapies by doing an early and automated diagnosis of AIS. A computerized method for segmenting ischemia lesions should be developed to reduce time consumption and avoid clinical error. This paper introduces the segmentation techniques based on the Deep learning algorithm by creating an eleven-layer deep, double pathway, 3D Convolutional Neural Network. After analyzing a relevant multi-modal 3D MRI-like Diffusion Weighted Imaging (DWI) patch at various scales, the created system segments pathologies voxel-wise. For training and testing, this study uses 255 examples with five-fold validation. After postprocessing, it outperformed other approaches with a high Dice mean value of 0.82 on the datasets of ISLES 2022. The implemented network can process a 3D brain volume of different sizes within 3 minutes, making it relevant to broader research cohorts' automated analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient design of approximate adders for FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In this paper, efficient design of approximate adders to effective utilization of the FPGA resources are proposed. The designs are proposed to analyze the differences between power, area and delay in the adders. The following are the approximate adders such as low error and area efficient approximate adder (LEADx), area and power efficient approximate adder (APEx) and high speed and power efficient approximate adder (HSPEx). This type of adders consists of two parts where the least significant part represents approximate adder and most significant part represents accurate adder. The purpose of the approximate adder is to lessen the power, area and delay in the adders. LEADx and APEx has more delay compared to HSPEx approximate adder. HSPEx significantly reduces more area compared to APEx and APEx reduces more area compared to LEADx approximate adder. The HSPEx approximate adder uses the inner stage input-output pipelining technique to reduce the use of LUTs and increase the speed of the adder whereas APEx adder uses truncation technique by fixing constant 1 to some of bits in the adder. Compared to other approximate adders the HSPEx adder absorbs relatively less power. The synthetization and simulation of the proposed method is performed using Xilinx VIVADO.

articleTitle: Classification of Pista Species using Fine-Tuned EfficientNetB3 Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Pistachios are popular and essential commercial nuts that have varying aesthetic qualities depending on the variety. Farmers, suppliers, and food processors must accurately classify pistachio varietals to maintain quality standards and tailor marketing campaigns based on consumer preferences. This study employs the EfficientNetB3 transfer learning model with fine-tuning layers to organize images of pistachios. The aim is to create a reliable and precise picture classification system that can tell the difference between the two pistachio types, Kirmizi and Siirt. There are 2148 labelled images in the dataset, which were divided into training, validation, and test batches at random. Transfer learning is carried out using EfficientNetB3, a potent DCNN that was pretrained on a sizable dataset and refined using the pistachio dataset. The EfficientNetB3 transfer learning model produced exceptional outcomes, with a pistachio classification accuracy of 99.5%. The model's high accuracy demonstrates the model's capability to accurately recognize and differentiate between the Siirt and Kirmizi pistachio types. The study shows that even with little datasets, transfer learning and fine-tuning approaches may be used to use deep learning models that have already been trained and adapt them to particular image categorization tasks. The automatic quality evaluation and variety identification of pistachios are made possible by the suggested image classification system, which substantially impacts the food and agriculture industries. Accurate categorization increases the pistachio production process's effectiveness and financial viability by promoting targeted marketing and improving quality control. The findings demonstrate the potential real-world uses of the EfficientNetB3 model in various picture classification tasks while demonstrating an effective method for classifying pistachios.

articleTitle: Detecting Brain Tumors in MRI’s using a Convolutional Neural Network with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: THIS PAPER describes a method for finding brain cancers in MRI scans by utilising a convolutional neutral network with transfer learning. Brain tumour detection is the process of locating anomalies in brain structure that suggest the existence of a tumour. The CNN model is trained to divide the input MRI data into two categories: tumor-affected and normal. Many measures, including accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, were used to assess performance of the method by VGG16. This method could make it easier for doctors to quickly and reliably diagnose brain tumours in patients.

articleTitle: Using Augmented Reality to enhance the experience of IoT-based Home Automation Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is an integral part of home automation, where physical devices are interconnected such that, they enable communication amongst electronics, sensors, software, and network. The data collection and analysis in IoT, and unified framework in cloud computing strives to improve living standards and productive outcomes by interacting with smart devices. In various fields such as education, control, and entertainment, Augmented Reality (AR) technology attempts to improve user experiences through improved interactions within the available settings. This paper presents an IoT based Home Automation System, which uses Augmented Reality as an additional technology to enable utilization of real time visualization and interaction for better experience. The application is beneficial for children, elderly and differently abled persons as it would aid them with control of electrical appliances just by scan through a device camera, connected to internet. From a safety perspective also, it offers electrical isolation.

articleTitle: Role of IoT in Precision Agriculture and Detecting and Classifying Rice Leaf Diseases using CNN Method of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Precision Agriculture means applying new IoT technologies to do smart farming to increase the crops’ yield with minimal human activities. This article presents many of the IoT technologies used in Precision Agriculture over traditional one and its applications. By using IoT technology we can detect the soil type, soil content, soil moisture, growth of the crops, crops infected by insects & weeds, dozing of fertilizers, herbicides, insecticides and fungicides periodically. This article presents about the various types of sensors used for smart farming like Light Sensor, Pressure Sensor, Temperature Sensor, Moisture Sensor, Proximity & Motion Sensors, Sound Sensor, Image Sensor, Magnetic Sensor, Air Quality and Water Quality Sensors. This paper also discusses the technologies used in IoT based agriculture that involves network architecture and layers, network topologies used and protocols. The captured sensor data gives information about environmental condition which is in turn used for detecting various soil parameters and crops’ yield. The use of rotation of crop varieties and the efficient application of agro chemicals extremely contribute to increase the crops’ productivity. The data captured by the sensors are analysed and is used for monitoring and controlling. This paper also summarizes monitoring and controlling of agriculture. Monitoring involves three main applications in smart agriculture. They are Live Stock Monitoring, Field Monitoring, and green house Monitoring. This paper also presents the detection of leaf diseases for rice leaf using deep learning method and to classify the disease type.

articleTitle: Multiple plant leaf disease detection using efficient Machine learning classification techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: accurate diagnosis of plant diseases is essential for reversing declines in crop output. To study plant illnesses, one must examine the outward symptoms produced by the plant in question. It is also essential for long-term husbandry that plant health be monitored and complaints about diseases made. Disease auditing in plants is tedious work that requires special equipment. It takes a huge commitment of time, courage when dealing with plant illnesses, and fortitude to endure the devilishly long processing time. As a result, landing the photos of the leaves and comparing it with the data sets is how image processing is employed for the detection of plant conditions. To learn to distinguish between photos of unhealthy and healthy leaves, a group of computers is trained on datasets of both types. In conclusion, we now have a straightforward method to descry the complaint existent in crops at a massive scale by employing machine learning to train on the vast data sets available privately. To aid greenhouse growers, this report has been written.

articleTitle: Pulse Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (PNOMA) Technique for Future Generation Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The foundation of Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) is providing services to several consumers at once while using the same resource in terms of frequency, time, and area. In this research, we provide a novel approach to reducing complexity and power consumption by using ideas from pulsed NOMA systems. The strategy is quite versatile and may be used with numerous other systems. The improvement that we suggest differs from the OFDM system in that the amplitude shaping pulse of the OFDM modulation uses pulses with duty cycles. The time domain spectrum of the modulated signals is spread out by pulsing NOMA symbols, resulting in a spreading gain that is inversely proportional to the duty cycle of the pulsed subcarriers. We show that the additional diversity may be completely utilized by a pulsed-NOMA receiver without the need for OFDM receivers. It is demonstrated that while pulsed NOMA receivers outperforms with OFDM receivers, it also offers advantages over NOMA receivers in terms of intrinsic low complexity and low power consumption.

articleTitle: Unlocking Solar Potential: Maximizing Efficiency through Donor Density Variations in MAPbI3 Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The SCAPS simulation program is used in the study to look into the impact of donor density variations on the concert of MAPbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> based photovoltaic (PV) cells. In order to determine its effect on the PV parameters J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf>, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf>, and FF, the donor density in a perovskite buffer film based on MAPbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is being changed in this investigation. Graphs for EQE, J-V curves, PV parameters and EBD are used to display the results. For an understanding of the cell's functionality, it is essential to see how the EBD depicts the energy levels of charge carriers in distinct PV cell layers. Additionally, a rise in acceptor density results in a beneficial boost in V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf>, although a rise in acceptor density causes a modest decline in J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf> due to fewer available charge carriers. EQE is unaffected by variations in donor density. According to the research, increasing donor density causes FF to steadily increase, indicating improved charge extraction and decreased recombination. In the end, a donor density of 1 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> results in the optimal PV properties, such as FF of 81.44%, J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SC</inf> of 15.46 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OC</inf> of 1.33V, and PCE of 16.77%. These discoveries open the door to more effective and sustainable solar energy conversion while also having important implications for improving PSCs and developing renewable energy technology.

articleTitle: Bone Marrow Cell Classification Using Efficientnet B5 Transfer Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In order to diagnose and treat a wide range of bone marrow (BM) monitor is a extremely important step. The most important and essential information is contained in the BM nucleated differential count (NDC) analysis, which is a component of the analysing of BM. In this work, the capability of a trained CNN model to classify images of BM cells is evaluated. Therefore, it is crucial to create a deep learning automated categorization system for BM cells. Traditional classification artificial intelligence algorithms, however, only generate classification results. The outcomes of the study demonstrate that the proposed method has an accuracy of 96.72%. If several BM cell types are analysed, this will be useful for tracking conditions including thrombocytopenia, polycythaemia vera, anaemia, as well as some cancers like leukaemia, lymphoma, and multiple myeloma. It helps to increase the healthy quality of life. It can significantly increase the efficiency and precision of identifying BM cells.

articleTitle: Smart Electric Vehicle Charging System Using RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have gained popularity in recent years due to their environmental friendliness and low operating costs. However, the inconvenience of traditional EV charging methods has been a major barrier to widespread adoption. In this paper, we propose a smart wireless EV charging system that uses the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technologies to improve the convenience and efficiency of EV charging. The system allows for automatic charging without the need for physical contact between the charging pad and the EV, thanks to the use of wireless power transfer technology. The system is also equipped with real-time monitoring and control capabilities, allowing users to check the status of their EVs and charging sessions via a mobile app. Additionally, RFID technology is used to enable secure and seamless authentication of the EV and the user. The proposed system has been simulated and evaluated in terms of its performance and energy efficiency, and the results show promising performance. This paper presents a step towards a smarter and more sustainable transportation system.

articleTitle: Dermatologist-Level Classification of Skin Cancer Using Cascaded Ensembling of Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Skin cancer is a typical frequent malignancy that is typically identified visually after an initial screening, dermoscopic analysis, a biopsy, and histological investigation. Using photographs to automatically classify skin lesions is a difficult task, but convolutional neural networks (CNN) have the capacity to perform a wide range of broad and highly variable tasks across many fine-grained object categories. Malignant melanoma, often known as melanoma, is the deadliest type of skin cancer and is to blame for 75 percentage of skin cancer-related deaths while being the least frequent type. Deep learning methods were employed by the suggested system to recognize melanoma. The proposed approach, which makes use of clinical photos, could help a dermatologist identify this sort of skin cancer early on. Here, the input photos undergo pre-processing to lessen any lighting and noise artefacts that may be present. The pre-trained CNN then uses the improved images to identify which is malignant and which is benign .

articleTitle: Animal Intrusion Detection System: Protected Crops and Promoted Safety using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Animal assaults on crops were one of the main causes of the precipitous drop in agricultural output. The expansion of farmland into once wild areas has led to an increase in crop raiding, one of the most acrimonious human-animal clashes. The harvests of Indian farmers were significantly impacted by pests, natural disasters, and animal damage. Since it was too expensive to hire guards to keep an eye on crops and keep wild animals away, farmers stuck to ineffective old ways. To prevent agricultural damage by animals and to reroute animals without harming them, it was essential to ensure everyone's safety. Animal identification using machine learning helps us solve the aforementioned challenges and reach our objectives. In this study, pictures of the whole farm were taken at regular intervals. The photographs were broken down using the Watershed technique. The features of the training set are retrieved by use of a 2D Gabor filter bank. Classification is performed with the Support Vector Machines method. The percentage of correct responses for each test image is determined.

articleTitle: Early diagnosis of cervical cancer using Machine Learning approaches: Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The disease that has the greatest effect on people is cancer. The analysis of previous cancer cases aided in determining the progressions that should be made with high-risk patients to lower the risk they face. Cervical cancer might potentially develop from these cells. The dataset gathered from Kaggle for predicting the likelihood of cervical cancer was used in the proposed study. No values for data were missing within the assessment of the collected data. A model for prediction that was developed as a result of this research can help determine if an individual has cervical cancer or not. Utilizing classification accuracy, F1-measure, recall, and precision, the predictive system's effectiveness is evaluated. An analysis comparison has been carried out based on the outcom8es of different algorithms used for machine learning. The proposed approach uses a variety of machine learning classification algorithms, with the Random Forest (RF) showing the highest accuracy 96.8% in predicting cancer among patients.

articleTitle: Ensemble Classification for Stroke Prediction and Diagnosis: Enhancing Accuracy through Collaborative Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The harmful effects of stroke on society have prompted joint efforts to enhance stroke management and diagnosis. The merging of technology with medical diagnosis opens doors for improved patient care, achieved by systematically extracting and storing patients' medical records. This emphasizes the need of examining how numerous risk factors are interrelated and affect stroke prediction in patients' medical records. For accurate stroke prediction, this study systematically examines these factors. Employing diverse statistical techniques, the data is refined through preprocessing and the removal of anomalies. In addition, an ensemble technique, fusing different boosting algorithms, is anticipated to yield high accuracy and reduced miss rates compared to other methods.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Role of Reverse Engineering in Security Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Almost five billion people now use the internet for Various purposes like education, research, banking, and health. It became a vital part of our day-to-day life but it also increases the security threat to multiple folds. In 2022 Q2 particularly in DDoS application-layer attacks increased by 72% and network-layer attacks increased by 109%. In this paper, we identify the role of reverse engineering in attacks against the android-based banking application, IoT, wireless sensors systems, and Controllers area networks. We also study the techniques and tools of reverse engineering they use to lunch the attack. We also explain how DDoS Attacks launch on any android-based application using dynamic reverse engineering.

articleTitle: A Robust system for disaster detection and management model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Numerous advancements are produced as a result of the development of embedded computer systems and the science of sensors. In this research, a unique sensing network framework for the disaster gathering and analysis, comprising data on the actual surroundings and prospective surviving' messages, is discussed. A centralized information server and a large number of sensor devices make up the overall structure. The main database server supervises the sensor devices' internal ZigBee system, which is coordinated by them. For the purpose of being able to deliver comprehensive catastrophic event data globally, the server must be linked to the internet. An automated configuration that can travel to catastrophe sites and assess the viability of an individual's involvement was built into the framework.

articleTitle: Enhancing Trust and Privacy in E-Commerce Platforms by Preventing DNS Heavyweight Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: E-commerce is the largest platform of online business that provides users with a virtual environment for interaction related to buying and selling tasks. People prefer to purchase online to have more variety of products and to get items at discounted prices. But data privacy is a big concern in such scenarios where the user is communicating with E-Commerce platforms using their personal and financial details. The attacker can easily target the user and breach the data/ information and login credentials of the user by cyberattacks like domain name system attacks. Ingenious solutions for the early identification of Domain Name assaults for various e-commerce platforms may now be available as machine learning solutions can be deployed in real network environments as well. The strategy proposed in this research paper serves as a protective barrier for the Ecommerce platforms to prevent the breaching the information. The methodology is suggested to employ a trained machine smart loader chip for attack detection to make sure that only allowed data packets are transmitted to the domain name system server of the e-commerce system. The dataset used to train and test artificial intelligence algorithms is derived from the data repository of the Canadian Institute for Cyber Security. According to the findings, the decision tree classifier is the most effective technique for spotting domain name system attack infections at an early stage.

articleTitle: Fish Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In the current generation, people’s knowledge about the fish is reducing. So, they couldn’t classify the fishes based on their image because they look similar. That’s why we developed the model using deep learning technique to classify the fishes based on the images and also nowadays the demand of fishes is increasing and classifying the fishes are challenging.so this paper discusses the classification of fishes using the convolutional neural network which has image processing, feature extraction and image classification. The unwanted noise and distortion have been removed by image processing after that dimensionality is reduced with the help of feature extraction finally the image will classify based on the label. By using this method, we achieved 94%accuracy for the classification of the fishes using CNN.

articleTitle: Boruta Feature Selection for Prediction of Coronary Artery Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Day by day cardio vascular disease death cases increasing. It mainly affects the human heart and blood vessels and it is difficult to diagnosis it. In this paper various machine learning algorithm is used to predict the cardio vascular disease. The data set of 14 attributes is used for prediction. The irrelevant features are handled using Boruta algorithm of 100 iterations. The proposed work uses Adaboosting with different hyper parameter and the multiple decision trees are built for the wrongly classified feature. At finally the Adaboosting algorithm achieve 93.74% accuracy in predicting the disease.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Patch Antenna Using Pin Diode
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In this project a cpw fed reconfigurable antenna is designed and analysed for c band applications. This work is designed using ANSYS hfss and FR4 material is taken as the substrate material for analysis. The designed antenna is working at frequency range at 6.8GHz which covers the high-end range of c band covering all near by satellite communication applications. To enhance the gain characteristics of the antenna the metamaterial inspired split ring resonators having placed on top side of the patch for constant gain(4Db).The novelty of the antenna lies in the reconfigurability where 4 diodes are inserted for the reconfigurability of the obtained band. All the cases and reconfigurability have been discussed in the proposed work states that the proposed antenna is a suitable candidate for c band applications.

articleTitle: VM Consolidation Algorithm for Energyefficiency and Quality of Service
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Scheduling is undoubtedly one of the difficulties that the cloud, which is always developing, must overcome. Scheduling describes a specific method of arranging the tasks that a laptop device should complete in the correct order. In this study, we used FCFS and round-robin scheduling to construct a standard priority seek set of criteria for assignment execution and assessment. The method has been tested on the cloud, and the outcomes demonstrate that it outperforms several traditional scheduling techniques. In distributed computing systems, a variety of scheduling techniques are used, task scheduling being one of them. For resource optimization, we specifically cover three methods: ANT colony, analytic, and genetic algorithms. We developed a new precedence set of rules with a limited number of activities; in the future, we will take on additional jobs and work to reduce the implemented execution time. We may also expand this set of rules to the network environment and examine the time difference between the cloud and the network. The suggested approach is entirely based on queuing models. The burden, response time, and length of the common queue were all decreased by directing incoming requests to a low task. These results show that our version may increase the utilization of the global agenda while decreasing latency. The results of the experiments verified that the suggested version may lower power consumption, hence enhancing service quality inside the cloud architecture. Future iterations of the planned version would utilize cloud computing techniques built on parallel algorithms to speed up activation of user requests. We recommend the adoption of a heterogeneous resource allocation method called Skewness avoidance multi-resource allocation (SAMR) to distribute resources based on particular requirements for particular types of assets. Our approach comprises of a set of VM provisioning guidelines to ensurethat heterogeneous constraints are properly distributed to prevent resource overload across PMs and a model-based method to determine the most energetic mix of PMs SAMR should be running on. We will demonstrate the relatively low complexity of our model method for accurate and useful evaluation work. Many simulation results demonstrate SAMR's superior efficacy and overall performance to competitors.

articleTitle: An Artificial Industrial Intelligence Based Model for Efficient Scheduling to Perform Manufacturing and Execution of Commercial Machines Using Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The Machines are also used in parallel to humans in the current technology ages. In fact, the machines are now working on the basis of work and manuals handling it. Therefore, the technology that directly leads the machines has been developed as a global project. In that order of Industry 4.0, humans and mechanical sweets are made possible and its reliable jobs are conducted. Here is a flap introduction of machines managing machines in industry modes using low skill and workers. The mechanical needs of the machine are calculated and estimates of human resource and electricity requirements required managing them on its basis. This all the commands are designed to be provided by humans. Its accuracy is 98.27% and Energy Efficiency has given practical decisions to 98.56%. And the mechanical learning method of the automated ingredients depends on the jobs implemented in the inputs and commands offered. It is clear that the inputs are capable of 99.12%, and it is clear that the learning is quiet and clear.

articleTitle: Education Revolution using Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The development of a Web 3.0 education platform that leverages Virtual Reality (VR) videos, cryptocurrency payments, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbots enhances the learning experience. The paper aims at providing interactive learning for users using a decentralized platform. This Web application runs on the latest concepts like Blockchain and Machine Learning. The AI-supported chatbot uses the latest OpenAI concept to answer users’ queries. The platform allows users to buy courses using cryptocurrencies through the Metamask wallet and also enables material authors to earn profits built on the count of views their material collects. The AI chatbot, powered by OpenAI Application Programming Interface, provides free support to users by answering their queries related to studies. Upon payment, users receive a token code via email that they can use to access the video content through a mobile app with a VR box. The platform aims to democratize education by making it accessible and affordable for learners worldwide. The use of blockchain technology and virtual reality in education is still in its early stages, and this platform has the potential to revolutionize the education sector and make learning more accessible, engaging, and personalized.

articleTitle: Classifying mammographic images for predicting breast cancer using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In the whole world, breast cancer is among the most common and dangerous diseases affecting women’s health. For the identification of breast cancer to be effective and for patient outcomes to be improved, it must be done efficiently and precisely. The development of computer-aided diagnostic systems utilizing deep learning approaches has gained popularity as massive mammographic imaging datasets have been more widely available. In the suggested study, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used to categorizes breast cancer in great detail. CNNs are a viable method used for classifying breast cancer since they have demonstrated great effectiveness in a variety of medical image recognition tasks. The proposed methodology covers the most recent innovations, approaches, and difficulties related to CNN-based breast cancer categorization and has been tested on various parameters and achieved results as good as 98 percent the receiver operating characteristic curve's (AUC-ROC) area under the curve.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Automation Tool for NBA Evaluators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The National Board of Accreditation (NBA) was established by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) with the main objective to assess the qualitative competence of the programs offered by educational institutions in India from diploma level to post-graduate level. With the help of NBA automation tool the evaluation is automatically evaluated using the automation tool which makes the evaluation by the Mentor Institutes easier and also to avoid manual errors. In NBA Automation tool the Mentee Beneficiary Institutions can sign up and login into the portal and can upload the Self-Assessment Report (SAR) and can view their mentor assigned to them. The admin in turn can view all the newly signed up users of various Mentee Beneficiary Institutes and allocate them mentors to assist them during the Mock NBA process. Admin can view all the uploaded SAR, evaluators list and evaluated criteria report in his portal. The Evaluators evaluate the SAR report and award marks in the portal and can finally download the summary report as PDF and send it to the respective Mentee Beneficiary Institutions.

articleTitle: Intrusion Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In this day and age, substantial advances in the realm of security are being achieved at a quick pace. Because of the unexpected increase in the number of internet users, there is an increase in issues connected to hardware failure, software deployment failure, and memory allocation, which directly or indirectly results in data loss. [1] Network invasions entail the theft of important network resources, usually always through exploiting flaws in the group of networks and/or their data. Several hardware, software, and network elements can all contribute to network intrusion. Ineffective communication protocols, certain devices following their own protocol, proper file size constraints not defined, and poor firing are all software factors. Outdated routers, too many devices connected to a single router, and incompatible hardware are all examples of hardware factors. Network hacking, bad network architecture, and oversubscription are examples of unrelated factors. Our study intends to analyse the dataset, which includes all of the aforementioned parameters, using Ad boost classification, Stacking classification, Random Forest classifier, and Gaussian Nave Bayes Classifier.

articleTitle: A New Perspective on Sensitivity for Biosensing Applications in Nanocavity-Embedded Dual Metal Surrounding Gate TFETs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The dual metal surrounding gate tunnel FET (DMSG TFET) with nanocavity embedding is suggested in this work for biosensing applications. Surface potential, sensitivity, and threshold voltage are derived as the electrical parameters for biomolecules to use in the label-free detection. DMSG TFET is utilized because of its better electrostatic control that it possesses over the channel, which results in a lower threshold voltage for the device. The device's embedded nanocavity is exposed to the biomolecules, altering the threshold voltage. The observed disparity in the threshold voltage can be attributed to the device's level of sensitivity. The proposed technology employs a parabolic approximation technique to analytically resolve the 2-dimensional Poisson equation. For the proposed device, the outcomes of both the graphical simulation and the analytical modeling exhibit congruence. Additionally, the Single Metal Surrounding Gate Tunnel FET (SMSG TFET) is contrasted with the DMSG TFET in terms of sensitivity, and the graphical simulations of the parameters are examined and confirmed using the TCAD software tool.

Author Keywords: Double Metal Surrounding Gate Tunnel FET (DMSG TFET)

articleTitle: Development of Ai-Based Posture Monitoring System to Assist Yoga Training
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: In the modern era of remote fitness and wellness, maintaining correct posture during exercises and yoga practices is vital for maximizing the benefits and preventing injuries. However, monitoring one's posture can be challenging, often leading to improper form and reduced effectiveness. To address this issue, this project presents an innovative real-time posture monitoring system using computer vision and pose estimation techniques. The system employs the Mediapipe library to detect and analyze the user's body posture through a camera feed. It begins by capturing a reference posture from an image and calculating its landmark coordinates. These coordinates serve as the baseline for correct posture. As the user performs exercises in front of the camera, their live posture is continuously evaluated against the reference posture using Euclidean distance as a similarity metric. A crucial contribution of this project lies in its ability to provide immediate feedback to the user regarding their posture. The system visualizes landmarks on the user's body, highlighting correct and incorrect positions in distinct colors. If the similarity score between the live posture and the reference posture surpasses a certain threshold, the landmarks appear in green, indicating good posture. Conversely, red landmarks indicate discrepancies, prompting the user to adjust their form. Experimental results showcase the effectiveness of the proposed system in real-time posture assessment. Users can actively observe their posture and make necessary adjustments, fostering improved exercise outcomes and reduced risk of injuries. By offering a convenient and immediate feedback mechanism, this project bridges the gap between remote fitness practices and professional guidance, ultimately promoting safer and more effective workout routines

articleTitle: A Novel Prediction Technique for Idetifying Chronic Kidney Disease in data Analytics Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), which is mostly related to conditions like obesity and diabetes, is a significant cause of death and suffering in the modern day. As of 2017, the global prevalence of CKD reached a staggering 843.6 million individuals. Prompt identification of CKD stages holds paramount importance in mitigating potential complications including hypertension, anemia, and neurological disorders. Leveraging the power of machine learning, early detection of CKD is pursued, predominantly through binary and multiclass classification approaches. The repertoire of utilized models encompasses XgBoost, Ada Boosting, Decision Tree, Random Forest and Extra Tree Classifier. To foster a comprehensive understanding of the data and prepare features effectively, exploratory data analysis (EDA) and label encoding techniques are harnessed. Ada Boosting, with recursive feature elimination, outperforms other models like RF, XgBoosting, Extra Tree Classifier, and DT. The study's emphasis is on accurate stage prediction in CKD diagnosis. This research contributes to advancing precise CKD stage prediction methods. The findings highlight Ada Boosting's effectiveness in enhancing CKD diagnostic capabilities.

articleTitle: A Multi-Purpose Food Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to build the prototype of a personalized multi-purpose food recognition system for the purpose of recognizing the type of food, tracking the caloric content and giving the caloric content of the food, and provide the record of the user’s eating habits. Convolution Neural Network and Image processing techniques have been found increasingly useful in the food industry, particularly for food detection applications. Research in this area suggests of using CNN to improve product quality. Here, We are going to use CNN based automatic food detection system which will be detecting the various food and is designed along with multiple features. This type of approach enhances the user experience of finding and analyzing the type of food that better suits their taste.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Oral Cancer Research: A Web of Science Database Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: This paper presents a bibliometric analysis of oral cancer research during the last five years using data from the Web of Science database. The study's goal is to give a thorough overview of oral cancer publishing trends, coauthorship patterns, nation contributions, keyword co-occurrence, citation analysis, and source analysis.According to the data, the number of papers on oral cancer has been steadily increasing, demonstrating a continued interest in research. Coauthorship analysis finds notable writers who have made substantial contributions to the subject, while country analysis identifies major contributors such as the United States, India, and China.Keyword co-occurrence analysis uncovers prominent research themes within oral cancer, offering insights into important areas of study. Citation analysis identifies highly cited papers that have made significant impacts on the field. Source analysis identifies influential publishing outlets that disseminate oral cancer research. The findings offer valuable insights for researchers, policymakers, and stakeholders in guiding future research and advancing knowledge in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of oral cancer.

articleTitle: Texture Features Retrieval using Convolutional Neural Networks for Multiclass Classification of Plant Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Early leaf detection is essential to India's rapidly growing agricultural industry. Early plant leaf issues identification and the creation of forecasting techniques are crucial for the agriculture industry to fulfill its task of nourishing the entire population. Recently, analysis of images and automated vision algorithms have been used to images of pepper plant, tomato and potato plant leaves in order to detect illnesses in these plants. These approaches are used to obtain leaf image characteristics using either deep learning frameworks or specially developed methodologies. This article proposes a VGG19 model, based on transfer learning to address plant diseases. To train the model, the Plant Village dataset has been employed. There are 15 distinct leaf classifications in this dataset. The RMSprop optimizer has been employed to train the VGG19 model across 40 iterations with a batch size of 64 and a minimal learning rate of 0.0001. With a training accuracy of 97.85% and a testing accuracy of 96.98%, the model has performed effectively when categorizing images of the plant disease leaves. This study can be applied in the agricultural sector to identify plant illnesses early.

articleTitle: An Improved Brain Tumor Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Sources indicate that tumors are among the leading causes of mortality, ranking third after heart and cancer conditions. In particular, brain tumors are one of the most prevalent and serious forms of tumors, underscoring the need for timely medical intervention. The majority of tumors are classified as ischemic tumors and hemorrhage tumors. The utilization of a deep learning model for predicting tumor growth patterns in the brain using a brain complaint dataset is a multi-phase process. The four distinct phases involved in this method are pre-processing, Brain Midline Tracking, Feature Extraction, and Classification. The classification stage employs SVM and KNN algorithms for predicting tumor behavior. Nevertheless, the method exhibits inadequate accuracy and imposes substantial memory requirements. Furthermore, it is incapable of detecting tumor hemorrhage and only detects 60 to 65% of Ischemic cases.

articleTitle: Optimising Trading Strategies using Linear Regression on Stock Prices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Stock price prediction is a challenging endeavour since it is highly dependent on stock demand, and there is no single characteristic that can correctly predict the demand of one stock each day. The proposed method intends to offer traders a reliable framework for optimizing their trading strategies based on historical data and linear regression analysis. This method involves identifying variables that affect stock prices, such as historical stock prices and economic indicators. The project outlines the steps to create two accurate models for predicting stock prices and EMA_10(Exponential Moving Average), which includes data cleaning, prioritization, training the model with appropriate algorithms like Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), and evaluating its performance using metrics like Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error(MAE). The proposed method is implemented using Python and can provide valuable insights into future trends of stock prices. With the proposed trading strategy investors can make informed decisions and minimize their risk in the stock market.

articleTitle: Secured Electronic voting system using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Electronic voting has become an increasingly popular topic of discussion in recent years but it has some security issues. Ethereum's smart contract capabilities make it possible to develop tamper-proof and transparent e-voting systems. Smart contracts are self-executing programs that are stored on the Ethereum blockchain, and can be used to automate the process of voting and ensure that the results are accurate and verifiable. This paper explores the use of Ethereum for e-voting, including the advantages and challenges of using this platform for voting. The paper discusses the use of smart contracts for implementing e-voting systems, the security and privacy considerations that must be taken into account, and the potential benefits of using Ethereum for e-voting. The paper also discusses the challenges that must be overcome to ensure the widespread adoption of Ethereum-based e-voting systems, including issues related to scalability, interoperability, and regulatory compliance. In conclusion, this paper argues that Ethereum has the potential to revolutionize the field of e-voting, offering a secure, transparent, and efficient solution for conducting political elections. While there are still many challenges to overcome, the use of Ethereum for e-voting represents an exciting opportunity for governments, businesses, and individuals around the world to participate in democratic processes in a more secure and efficient way.

articleTitle: Estimation of Varietal Classification and Quality Analysis in Rice Seeds Using Digital Image Processing – A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Research Methodologies in Knowledge Management, Artificial Intelligence and Telecommunication Engineering (RMKMATE)
abstract: Agriculture plays a major role in today’s world. 70% of rice production is cultivated in south India. Thailand, the US, India, Vietnam, etc., are exporting rice all over the world. But they are facing one of the most difficult tasks: assuring the rice seed quality. Good seeds can increase production, so selecting seeds is very important. A maximum of the work was done physically or by using huge, expensive machines. For choosing good seeds, agronomists be conscious of two factors, such as the variety which is determined by some quality criteria, and next by the skilled one who is going to analyze the rice seed physically. Both tasks take a long time and the result of accuracy is also not as expected. Nowadays computer vision technology with Digital Image Processing plays a major role in many fields, namely agronomy, healthcare, machine vision, pattern recognition, remote sensing, Video processing, etc. Our research work mainly focuses on the agricultural arena, going to provide good quality seeds and identify dissimilar varieties of rice seeds by digital image processing techniques such as image capturing, segmenting the rice seeds, extracting the features from the rice seeds and finally feeding into the machine learning algorithm to find out the accuracy too.
